source_rule: Index is derived navigation metadata only; results must open/fetch the preserved source and never substitute index text for canon.

algorithm.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, curly apostrophe→ASCII apostrophe
algorithm.tokenization: Unicode letter/number words with internal apostrophe/hyphen
algorithm.hash: SHA-256; hashes use 16-bit big-endian digest chunks 0..4 modulo 4096
algorithm.candidate_rule: All query-token bits must be present; then fetch preserved source and exact-normalized-match to reject Bloom false positives. No index false negatives occur for normalized tokens.
algorithm.phrase_rule: After token candidate filtering, confirm normalized phrase against fetched source text.

structured_joins.character_entity_tags: data/zubaida-character-links.json when available; exact source text remains fallback
structured_joins.session_labels: indexed from exact source lines beginning with Session/SESSION; stable session anchors intentionally deferred to ZUB-SESS-002

query_procedure: Load only Bloom shards needed (all shards for global search).
Require all query-token Bloom bits for a candidate transmission.
Fetch the preserved sources/zubaida/<id>.txt and confirm exact normalized token/phrase match before displaying result; this removes Bloom false positives.
Use ZUB-001/ZUB-002/entity joins for date/thread/concept/entity result metadata; never present index metadata as source canon.
